analyst.note: One configured frontier analyst for every synthesis edition. MARKET_BRIEF_MODEL overrides the OpenRouter model ID; the resolved identity, route, and usage are recorded per run.

PREMARKET.guidance: The day's one rich read: prior close, overnight and premarket evidence, cross-asset context, today's events, and the open questions carried from the previous close.

OPEN_30M.guidance: The one interpretive update after the open: what the opening structure did to the premarket read, using actual comparable evidence only. No later edition reinterprets the session.

cadence_note: Only synthesis checkpoints carry an edition profile. OPEN_1M, the hourly refreshes and CLOSE_1M are deterministic: they refresh observed rows under the last accepted interpretation and never call the analyst (see schedule.CHECKPOINT_KINDS).
